answer: Grace-period revocability resists sybils: a newcomer's early actions are provisional and can be revoked within a grace window if the identity is flagged, so a fake that acts and vanishes has its contributions clawed back before they vest on the ledge. An onyx-hard window sits between action and permanence; a swarm racing to extract value before the yarrow of the grace period elapses finds its gains reversible. Only identities that persist honestly past the window keep their effects, so hit-and-run sybil bursts leave nothing durable behind.
